subject: Consolidated next steps: multi-stakeholder demo and evidence intake
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@silvergatehealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@silvergatehealth.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidated next steps: multi-stakeholder demo and evidence intake

Hi Alex / Priya — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock a demo and bring the right teams in.

Recap (very short):
- Goal: validate Redwood's inference runtime for Silvergate Health's clinical-note summarization workflow and confirm security/procurement path for a pilot.
- Key stakeholders on your side: Alex (prod lead), Priya (security) — Alex suggested procurement might join later.

Proposed next steps:
1) 60-minute technical demo + 30-minute security breakout (90 min total).
2) We’ll cover model selection, inference latency profile, KV caching implications for your token shapes, and integration points for SSO + data flows.
3) Procurement checklist + contracting path reviewed in a follow-up if we get pilot-level buy-in.

Proposed demo windows (all PT):
- Tue Mar 16, 10:00–11:30am
- Wed Mar 17, 9:00–10:30am

Attachments: I attached a draft-demo-agenda.pdf and a security-evidence-checklist.xlsx to make it easier for security/procurement to triage what they need. If either of those should be shared with anyone on your side before the demo, let me know.

Ask from your side: please confirm which window works and provide the person we should include from procurement (name + email).

If helpful I can loop in Soojin (our security lead) and Markus (procurement lead) once you confirm a slot — they can then provide a short prep doc for the meeting.

Best,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com

From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@silvergatehealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@silvergatehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidated next steps: multi-stakeholder demo and evidence intake

Grace — great summary, thanks. Both windows look possible on our side; Priya (cc) is our security lead and will weigh in on the evidence checklist. For procurement, loop in Michael Chu (michael.chu@silvergatehealth.com) — he runs vendor contracting.

My preference is Tue Mar 16, 10:00–11:30am PT. If that works for your team, lock it and include whoever you need from security/procurement.

Alex
Alex Morgan
Head of Product, Silvergate Health
alex.morgan@silvergatehealth.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@silvergatehealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@silvergatehealth.com>, Michael Chu <michael.chu@silvergatehealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidated next steps: multi-stakeholder demo and evidence intake

Thanks Alex — Tue 16 10:00am PT locked on our side. 

Looping in internal leads: Soojin Lee (security) and Markus Klein (procurement) to introduce them to the checklist and procurement path. Diego (SE) will run the technical portion and I’ll handle the integration/architecture walkthrough.

Soojin / Markus — quick context: Silvergate Health is evaluating us for a pilot around clinical-note summarization (PII/PHI implications). Alex prefers Tue 10am PT for a 90-minute session (60 tech + 30 security). I attached the running demo agenda and the evidence checklist we shared earlier.

A couple of asks for the meeting prep:
- Soojin: can you confirm which items from security-evidence-checklist.xlsx you want to cover in the breakout vs. post-demo follow-up? Also please call out any evidence you need in advance so Silvergate can prepare (logs, retention policies, SOC artifacts).
- Markus: procurement, Michael — do you have any standard terms or procurement questions we should prepare for? If you prefer we can do a separate procurement call after the demo; otherwise we can run a 10–15 minute procurement overview at the end.

Calendar invite will include a shared Drive link to the agenda and a short pre-demo questionnaire (one page) for Silvergate to confirm SSO endpoints and sample payloads.

Thanks all — see you Tue.

Best,
Grace

Attachments: draft-demo-agenda.pdf, security-evidence-checklist.xlsx, procurement-path.docx

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@silvergatehealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@silvergatehealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidated next steps: multi-stakeholder demo and evidence intake

Thanks — I’ll take the security breakout. Quick note on evidence and the demo flow:

Security breakout (30 min) — proposed agenda
- 5 min: security posture overview (Redwood hosting modes + private options)
- 10 min: data flow & encryption (in-flight & at-rest), KMS/HSM options
- 10 min: logging, audit trails, retention controls (what we can demonstrate live)
- 5 min: outstanding evidence list & next steps

Items I’d like Silvergate to have available (if possible) before the session:
- Typical sample payload (redacted) showing max tokens per request
- Any specific retention/PII policies that will affect ingestion
- Contact for their SSO/IdP engineer (for SSO config questions)

If they can’t provide those in advance we can still run the demo; we’ll just triage remaining evidence in the follow-up. Markus — if procurement wants a 10–15 minute check-in at the end, I’m fine to include that as a soft close.

See you Tue at 10am PT.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
